sprint_name: SFT EOS-Collapse Root-Cause Investigation, Dataset Provenance Audit & Training Safety
status_summary: Root-cause investigation of EOS collapse successfully diagnosed: the failure mode is caused by severe overfitting on a tiny 37-example dataset sampled over 10.8 effective epochs, coupled with prompt format distribution mismatch. Provenance audit revealed 11 verified grounded records and 2 unsupported records (misattributed source files). Training Gate remains BLOCKED until larger-scale, grounded instruction datasets and length regularization are incorporated. 33/33 regression tests passed.

confirmed_root_causes: Dataset Scale & Epoch Overfitting: 37 examples trained over 200 steps (batch size 2 = 400 samples, ~10.8 epochs) drove EOS probability to the top rank.
Prompt Format Distribution Mismatch: Training on unformatted raw strings caused SFT model to fail when prompted with chat conversation wrappers.
refuted_hypotheses: Tokenizer Special Token Insertion (Tokens encode cleanly)
Causal Target Shifting Alignment (Input-target shift is mathematically correct)
Runtime Generation Artifact (Model genuinely predicts EOS at step 0)

Phase_3_Verify_Data_Provenance_Honestly.unsupported_details: TR-CD-01 and TR-CD-02 contained python attention logic misattributed to code_foundation.txt and stage_b_algorithms.txt.

Phase_5_Fair_Candidate_Evaluation.summary: Base Step 10,000 maintains continuous token generation across 90% of prompts. SFT Step 50 and 200 exhibit progressive EOS collapse.

Phase_6_Training_Readiness_Gate.rationale: Training must remain BLOCKED until a sufficiently large (>500 examples), rigorously source-grounded SFT corpus is prepared and length-penalty or loss regularization is implemented to prevent catastrophic EOS overfitting.
